messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites MS C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<original_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
//	freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
//	freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
	string s;
	cin >> s;
	int atpos = -1;
	for (int i = 1; i < s.length() - 1; ++i)
		if (s[i] == 'a' && s[i + 1] == 't' && i + 1 != s.length() - 1) {
			atpos = i;
			break;
		}
	cout << s[0];
	for (int i = 1; i < s.length(); ++i) {
		if (i + 2 < s.length() && s[i] == 'd' && s[i + 1] == 'o' && s[i + 2] == 't' && i+2 != s.length()-1) {
			cout << '.';
			i += 2;
			continue;
		}
		if (i == atpos) {
			cout << '@';
			++i;
			continue;
		}
		cout << s[i];
	}
	return 0;
}
</original_code>
